import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:300]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:300])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

# deep definition chain used as a capture part (windowed reads over a deep tree)
n = 3000
defs = [["d0","b'0123456789'"]]
for i in range(1, n):
    defs.append(["d%d"%i, "d%d+b'y'"%(i-1)])
total = 10 + (n-1)
req = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n' % total
doc = base(definitions=defs,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":req.decode('latin-1')},
                                          {"case":"a","data":"{{d%d}}"%(n-1)}]}])
t0=time.time(); r = run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   deep chain time %.2fs' % dt)
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('deep chain error', ch['error'], None)
check('deep chain n', ch['requests'][0]['body']['n'], total)
# reference: b'0123456789' + b'y'*(n-1)
def fpb(b):
    h=0
    for x in b: h=(h*257+x+1)%(2**64)
    return '%016x'%h
check('deep chain hash', ch['requests'][0]['body']['h'], fpb(b'0123456789'+b'y'*(n-1)))
check('deep chain owners', ch['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a', len(req)+total]])

# wide concat definition (many terms via nesting through definitions)
defs2 = [["a0","b'ab'"]]
for i in range(1, 60):
    defs2.append(["a%d"%i, "a%d+a%d"%(i-1,i-1)])
doc = base(definitions=defs2,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 16\r\n\r\n"},
                                          {"case":"a","data":"{{a3}}"}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('doubling defs', (r['channels'][0]['error'], r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['body']['n']), (None,16))
check('doubling hash', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['body']['h'], fpb(b'abababababababab'))

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
